category_title: Year 11 pupils who are demotivated by public reprimands and prioritize task-based feedback over behavioral rewards
minimal_context: The student is working on classroom tasks to achieve overall success.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please focus on your classroom tasks.

STUDENT: I'm looking at my grades. Getting low marks is the greatest motivator to work hard for my overall success.

TUTOR: You need to stop talking. I am telling you off in front of the class.

STUDENT: Being told off in front of the class is demotivating in relation to working hard. Public criticism of behaviour just makes me do less work.

TUTOR: If you don't get back to work, you will be made to miss break.

STUDENT: (Switches off completely) Being made to miss break just makes me dislike the teacher. I'm going to mess about and do less work now.

options.A: Implement reward strategies, including tick charts and token systems.
options.B: Issue the sanction of a verbal warning during the classroom tasks.
options.C: Simplify the instructions provided during the current classroom tasks.
options.D: Provide a clear beginning and end for the classroom tasks.
